_comment: Exam calendar (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §10.5). Official dates only, copied from ICAI's own announcement on the day in `checked`; build.py validates this file and ships it as manifest.exam. `days` lists every Group II exam day of the attempt; `papers` maps each paper code to its day(s). ICAI's announcement No. 13-CA (EXAM)/JANUARY/2027 (23 Sep 2026) gives the Group II days (8, 10 and 12 January 2027, 2 PM to 5 PM IST, 15 minutes' reading time from 1.45 PM); the paper on each day follows ICAI's Group II order (Paper 4, then 5, then 6), which the admit card confirms. Add the next attempt when ICAI announces it; never guess one.

cycles.label: CA Inter January 2027
cycles.note: Dates as announced by ICAI (Important Announcement of 23 September 2026); the paper on each day follows ICAI's Group II order. Verify on icai.org and your admit card.
